title: Nova Buddy AI — Your Everyday AI Assistant
excerpt: Free AI chat, 5 chat personalities, your own AI avatar, and Buddy Tools. Buddy Plus from $4.99 CAD/mo — launch deal: first month $1.99 CAD with code LAUNCH199.
content_html:
🎄 Christmas with Nova is here! Free holiday tools — Santa letters, a gift finder, card messages & more — plus our gift offer: buy Buddy Plus Lifetime, get 5 gift codes free for friends & family. See the Christmas page →

🎁 Nova's Advent Calendar opens December 1 — 24 doors of free Christmas tools, offers & surprises, and one door is hiding a giveaway. Bookmark it now so you don't miss a day →

Meet Nova, the assistant that keeps up with you.

Nova Buddy AI is your everyday AI assistant — ask it anything, draft anything, plan anything. It answers in seconds, remembers the conversation, and talks like a person, not a manual. Made for desktop and laptop, and it works on any device too — it just feels best on a bigger screen. No app to install, just open it in your browser.

No sign-up needed to start — tap one, or tap the 🎙️ mic in the chat and just talk:

  • Free to start — chat free every day, no card needed
  • Private by design — your chats stay in your browser. Buddy memory is optional, and what it remembers is stored with your account so it follows you on any device
  • Buddy Plus unlocks all 5 personalities: Friendly, Sharp, Playful, Motivator & Chill
  • Want one that's truly yours? Avatar AIs are included with Buddy Plus — $4.99 CAD/month
  • Works on every device, best on desktop & laptop — right in your browser, worldwide; every new account starts with 50 free Nova Gems

Talk to Nova right now

This is the real Nova Buddy AI chat, live. Type — or tap the 🎙️ mic and just talk — and hit 🔊 Listen on any reply to hear it out loud. After each answer, Nova suggests follow-up questions so you are never stuck on what to ask next. Buddy Plus members can flip the personality switch to hear its voice change.

Nova Buddy AI Online · replies instantly

Live AI: Nova is connected to a real AI service — ask it anything, right here, free.

🧠 Buddy remembers you Buddy Plus

Plus members can teach Buddy facts — your name, goals, favourites — and Buddy uses them in every chat.

One assistant, all the everyday stuff

Nova is built for the questions and tasks that fill a normal day — not just the impressive ones.

Ask anything

Explanations without the jargon, quick facts, ideas, advice. Nova answers in plain language and shows its working when it matters.

Write & polish

Emails, messages, captions, cover letters, tough conversations. Give Nova the rough version and get back the one you'd actually send.

Plan your day

Turn a messy to-do list into a realistic plan, prep for meetings, and break big projects into first steps you can start today.

Always on, in your voice

Pick Friendly, Sharp, or Playful and Nova keeps that tone across the whole conversation — like texting someone who knows how you like things.

Up and running in a minute

STEP 1

Create your account

Sign up free with your name and email, from anywhere in the world. No card, no trial traps — and you get 50 Nova Gems as a welcome bonus.

STEP 2

Pick a personality

With Buddy Plus, pick Nova's voice: Friendly for everyday help, Sharp when you want it brief, Playful when the day needs lightening — plus Motivator and Chill.

STEP 3

Just start talking

Type like you'd text a friend. Nova keeps the thread, so follow-ups like “make it shorter” just work.

Nova is free now

Every chat feature is free — 50 messages a day, no card — and Nova is available worldwide, wherever you are. Want your own Avatar AI, all 5 chat personalities and monthly Gems? That's Buddy Plus.

Free forever

Nova Buddy AI

$0 / forever

  • 50 messages a day
  • Welcome bonus: 50 free Nova Gems when you sign up
  • Nova's warm, friendly everyday tone
  • Writing, planning & everyday answers
  • Available worldwide, on phone and desktop

Monthly

Buddy Plus

$4.99 CAD / month

  • Unlimited chat messages — no daily cap
  • Your own Avatar AI included — designed by you
  • All 5 chat personalities — Friendly, Sharp, Playful, Motivator & Chill
  • Exclusive avatar items + Plus member badge
  • +200 Nova Gems when you join, 200 more monthly

Join Buddy Plus

Plus also unlocks 🧠 Buddy memory and full Buddy Tools in the Tools tab.

Lifetime

Buddy Plus — Lifetime

$79.99 CAD / once

Everything in Buddy Plus — unlimited messages, your own Avatar AI, all 5 personalities, Buddy memory and the monthly Gems — for one single payment. No renewals, no expiry, ever. It pays for itself in about two years of the annual plan.

Get Lifetime — $79.99 CAD once

Questions, answered

Is Nova a real AI?

Yes — Nova is powered by a live AI service, the same kind of technology behind today's best assistants. The chat right on this page is the real thing: ask it anything.

Is Nova really free?

Yes — chatting with Nova is completely free: guests get 10 messages a day; a free account gets 50 a day, no card required; Buddy Plus is unlimited. The only paid extra is Buddy Plus at $4.99 CAD/month (or $39.99 CAD/year) — it includes your own custom Avatar AI, all 5 chat personalities (Friendly, Sharp, Playful, Motivator & Chill), Buddy memory, and monthly Nova Gems. Launch deal: your first month is $1.99 CAD with code LAUNCH199.

What is an Avatar AI?

It's your own personal version of Nova. Over in the Avatars tab you design its look — skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, accessories — give it a name, choose from six personalities, and pick the language it greets you in. It's included with Buddy Plus ($4.99 CAD/month), or you can earn one free with referral Gems.

How do referral Gems work?

Every new account starts with 50 free Nova Gems as a welcome bonus. Then share your personal referral code with friends: every friend who joins earns you 100 more gems, and 499 gems buys a free Avatar AI — so five friends in, your next avatar is on us. Different avatar, different personality, no charge.

Is Nova available in my country?

Yes — Nova is available worldwide. Anyone with an internet connection can sign up free and chat from any country, and every new account starts with 50 free Nova Gems. Avatar AI greetings come in 7 languages, with more on the way.

Does Nova remember what I say?

Within a conversation, yes — follow-ups like “now make it funnier” work because Nova keeps the thread.

Nova is free — and your avatar is waiting.

Create a free account and say hello in under a minute, then design the Avatar AI that's unmistakably yours.

Buddy Plus — $4.99 CAD/month
